## Summary
Shahir Ahmed is a software engineer and M.S. Computer Science student at NYU (Sep 2026 to May 2028, expected). He was previously a software engineer at Sarva and a software engineer intern on FarmData2, and is ranked 31st of 800+ contributors to Mermaid.js. He works mostly in TypeScript, Java, and Python, with React, Next.js, Spring Boot, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and AWS.

## Experience
### Software Engineer, Sarva (May 2025 - Sep 2026), Carlisle, PA
Sarva is a startup that helps neighborhood grocery shops manage inventory by voice: owners track stock, get low-stock alerts, and see what sold by speaking in their own language. It also offers online ordering with pickup and delivery.
- Cut inventory update time by 60% by building a multilingual AI voice assistant in Next.js and TypeScript that lets store owners add or update multiple products by voice over WebRTC.
- Reduced zero-result searches by 17% by adding semantic search with OpenAI embeddings and Firestore vector queries to Algolia keyword search so shoppers can find products using natural language.
- Built a Stripe Connect payout system for vendors and drivers with Google Cloud Functions that retry failed transfers and use idempotency keys to prevent duplicate payments.
- Prevented overselling during concurrent checkouts by checking and reserving stock in atomic Firestore transactions.
- Created GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines that run 2,604 Vitest tests and check preview deployments before release.
- Built the product that put Sarva in the gener8tor and Meta gBETA accelerator and the Ship Tank and launchU finals.

### Software Engineer Intern, FarmData2 at Dickinson College (May 2024 - May 2025), Carlisle, PA
Paid internship on FarmData2, open source farm record-keeping software funded by the National Science Foundation.
- Developed crop seeding and tillage tracking in Vue.js through 25 merged pull requests to a National Science Foundation (NSF) funded open source platform that supports sustainability research and helps farmers manage field operations.
- Protected crop records with JavaScript rollback handlers that undo earlier writes when farmOS REST API calls fail.
- Wrote 70+ Cypress unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for data validation, record creation, and API failure recovery.

### Open Source Contributor, Mermaid.js (Jan 2025 - Apr 2025), Remote
Mermaid.js is an open source tool that turns text into flowcharts and diagrams, used by GitHub and Microsoft, with 15M+ weekly npm downloads.
- Added diagram features and fixed rendering bugs in TypeScript and D3.js for a library with 15M+ weekly downloads: data labels inside bar charts, Knuth-Plass word wrapping that keeps journey diagram legends from overlapping the diagram, and journey diagram title styling.
- Authored 3 merged pull requests with 22 Cypress regression tests by collaborating with maintainers and contributors.
- Ranked 31st of 800+ contributors on the repository's contributor graph as of October 2026.

### Student Researcher, Dickinson College and 84 Lumber (Sep 2023 - Jan 2024), Remote
- Built an ANTLR4 parser and abstract syntax tree (AST) translator to convert CBASIC into Python and Java.
- Co-designed a migration plan for 50,000+ lines of legacy code with 11 Dickinson students and 84 Lumber engineers.

## Projects
Listed in the same order as the projects page, strongest first.

### GrabPic
- URL: https://grab-pic.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shahir-47/Grab-Pic
- Event photo search. Upload a selfie to find your photos in albums of 500+ photos, matched in under 200 milliseconds. Built as 3 services (Next.js, Spring Boot, and a Python DeepFace/TensorFlow worker producing 512-dimension face embeddings), connected through Amazon SQS, with pgvector HNSW search, S3 presigned uploads, CloudFront signed URLs, per-IP Redis rate limiting in an atomic Lua script, and Cloudflare Turnstile. Compute later moved to Shahir's home server behind a Cloudflare Tunnel, cutting hosting from about $85 to about $1 a month.
- Tags: Full Stack, Backend, Databases, Distributed Systems, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Vector Search, Security, DevOps & Cloud, Self-Hosting, TypeScript, Java, Python, SQL, Lua, Next.js, React, Spring Boot, TensorFlow, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Redis, AWS, Supabase, Docker, Cloudflare, Tailwind CSS

### PaperPulse
- URL: https://paper-pulse-nu.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shahir-47/Paper-Pulse
- Research assistant that picks the 25 most relevant new papers from arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and OpenAlex for each user every night, ranked with neural reranking, and answers questions about them with retrieval augmented generation over pgvector and a Neo4j knowledge graph, streaming responses over Server-Sent Events. FastAPI and Next.js; the backend and Neo4j run in Docker on Shahir's home server.
- Tags: Full Stack, Backend, Databases, Machine Learning, AI & LLMs, Vector Search, Data Engineering, DevOps & Cloud, Self-Hosting, TypeScript, Python, SQL, Next.js, React, FastAPI, Neo4j, PostgreSQL, pgvector, OpenAI, Cohere, Docker, Supabase, Server-Sent Events, Tailwind CSS

### Home Server
- URL: https://lab.shahirahmed.com
- GitHub (live status page): https://github.com/Shahir-47/nitro-lab
- Self-hosted cloud on an Acer Nitro 5 laptop running Ubuntu Server. Runs the GrabPic, PaperPulse, and Queue Up backends in Docker behind Cloudflare Tunnel for about $1 a month instead of about $100 on AWS. No inbound ports are open on the router. Coolify builds each app from GitHub on push and configures Traefik routes; databases publish no ports. Private apps (Immich, Paperless-ngx, Uptime Kuma, Samba, Homepage) are reachable only over Tailscale. The public page is a Next.js app that streams host and container status with Server-Sent Events.
- Tags: DevOps & Cloud, Self-Hosting, Networking, Security, Real-Time, Frontend, JavaScript, Next.js, React, Docker, Linux, Cloudflare, Traefik, Coolify, Tailscale, Server-Sent Events

### Queue Up
- URL: https://queue-up.shahirahmed.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shahir-47/Queue-Up
- Social app that matches people by Spotify listening history, with real-time WebSocket chat. Java, Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL with Spring Data JPA, and Docker, self-hosted on Shahir's home server.
- Tags: Full Stack, Backend, Databases, Real-Time, Security, DevOps & Cloud, Self-Hosting, Java, JavaScript, SQL, Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, WebSockets, Docker, AWS, Spotify API

### CoSign
- URL: https://cosign-nwwl.onrender.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shahir-47/CoSign
- Task accountability app where users can't complete their own tasks. A verifier approves submitted proof through a task state machine, and if a deadline is missed the AES-encrypted hidden penalty is automatically emailed to the verifier. Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, WebSockets, Docker.
- Tags: Full Stack, Backend, Databases, Real-Time, Security, DevOps & Cloud, Java, TypeScript, SQL, Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, WebSockets, Docker

### PandOS
- GitHub: https://gitfront.io/r/Shahir-47/abfsq8dhTm4Z/Custom-OS-Kernel/
- Operating system kernel in C for the uMPS3 emulator that runs up to 20 processes on 5 ms round-robin time slices, with semaphores, TLB-based virtual memory, system calls, and interrupt handling.
- Tags: Operating Systems, Systems Programming, Concurrency, C, uMPS3

### BitTorrent Client JS
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shahir-47/bittorrent-client-js
- BitTorrent client in Node.js for .torrent files and magnet links, with TCP peer connections, SHA-1 piece verification, and extension protocol metadata exchange.
- Tags: Networking, Systems Programming, Distributed Systems, Concurrency, Algorithms, JavaScript, Node.js

### Albatross (HackHarvard 2024)
- URL: https://albatross-hack.netlify.app/
- Devpost: https://devpost.com/software/albatross
- Built after two teammates had felt unsafe walking through parts of Boston. A navigation app that routes walkers around high crime areas, built by a team of 4 in 36 hours, with a working demo for Boston. Clustered 50K+ crime records into risk zones with MLflow and stored them in a Databricks Delta Lakehouse. Vue.js, Cloudflare Workers, and the Google Maps API.
- Tags: Frontend, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, DevOps & Cloud, JavaScript, Python, Vue.js, Cloudflare, Databricks, MLflow, Google Maps API

- Devpost: https://devpost.com/software/sweetfriend
